caseNameFull: BRISTOL Et Al. v. HEATON Et Al.
attorneys: Appellants pro se., Will Wilson, Attorney General of Texas, James-N. Ludluni, First Assistant Attorney General, and Leonard' Passmore and John Reeves, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the' appeal is dismissed.,. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for certiorari, certiorari is denied.
